card.name: Digits in legal section citations
card.fires_on: The last digit of a section or regulation number in a legal citation (e.g. 21CFR 1306.07, Section 6606). It also fires on the period after a table number and on words after 'Section-16 of the Act deals'.

modes.label: Final digit of citation
modes.description: Last digit of a section or CFR number in a legal reference.

modes.label: Period after table number
modes.description: The full stop after 'Table 4' or 'Table 2' just before the table title.

modes.label: Words after Section of the Act
modes.description: Verbs and nouns following a statute section reference describing what it covers.
